title: In-Memory Mock Fallback Schema Parity Invariant
author: Brain Harness Reflector

claims.assertion: In-memory simulation fallbacks in Harness service plugins must maintain 100% dictionary key parity with live subprocess CLI and REST API payloads to prevent contract verification failures in offline test suites.

Omitting optional payload attributes (such as files_modified or report_path) from mock message inboxes causes downstream settlement deserialization to yield empty defaults, violating contract assertions.
